prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
The document proposes a wide-ranging program focused on constitutional change, economic reform, border control, public service restructuring, and sector-specific measures.

Sovereignty and governance
- Leave European political structures, replace EU law and schemes with UK law, regain an independent WTO seat, and use Swiss-style trade arrangements with Europe.
- Citizen-initiated binding referenda (5% threshold), AV+ electoral reform, right of recall, and abolition of regional government bodies.
- Devolution reform: national MPs to sit as devolved legislators part-time; English-only sittings; directly elected county boards for police, education, and health.
- Parliament to ratify treaties and consent to war; maintain monarchy and established church; review the second chamber.

Economy, tax, banking, and enterprise
- Raise the income tax threshold to £11,500; introduce a 31% flat tax merging income tax and employees’ NI; phase out employers’ NI over five years.
- Replace VAT with a Local Sales Tax, share business rates locally, cut council tax via scrapping certain levies, and aim to reduce the public sector to its 1997 size by cutting quangos.
- Abolish inheritance tax when affordable; scrap extensive EU-derived regulations.
- Restore the Bank of England’s prudential role, raise bank capital ratios to 8%+, separate retail and investment banking, and reintroduce lending controls.
- Major manufacturing and infrastructure programs (defence equipment, nuclear build-out, flood/coastal defences, transport links, prison construction).
- Production Enterprise Centres for SME support; amend takeover rules to protect strategic sectors; remove carbon-trading-style costs on business.

Immigration and asylum
- Five-year freeze on permanent settlement; thereafter a points-based cap (~50,000 p.a. aspiration).
- Exit-based border control, visas with health insurance (where no reciprocal cover), entry/exit recording, tripled border staffing, no amnesty for illegal residents.
- Asylum in first safe country, secure processing with limited appeals.
- Repeal the Human Rights Act and withdraw from the ECHR; reinstate the Primary Purpose Rule.

Law and order, defence
- Elected police boards; “life means life,” three-strikes policy, more homeowner protections, double prison capacity, boot camps for young offenders; withdraw from the European Arrest Warrant; abolish the CPS.
- Increase defence spending by ~40%: larger Army and Reserves, restored Navy with carriers, more RAF lift/rotary, maintain and replace nuclear deterrent, prioritize NATO, exit EU missions.

Health, education, welfare, pensions
- No frontline NHS cuts; elected health boards; replace layers of bureaucracy; franchise services under fixed budgets; optional health vouchers; empower matrons; hospital-based nurse training; restore free eye tests and dental check-ups.
- School vouchers; reinforce core literacy/numeracy; retain/expand selective and specialist schooling via comprehensive testing; on-the-job teacher training; merit-based university entry; some universities reoriented to vocational; student/training vouchers; abolish Ofsted, create a teacher-led inspectorate; stronger discipline; support special and home education.
- Simplify benefits into a Basic Cash Benefit; allow work without losing support up to the personal allowance; consolidate child support and introduce nursery vouchers; restrict benefits to citizens or 5+ year residents; workfare for some recipients.
- Citizen’s Pension of at least £130/week at 65, non-means-tested; target pension tax relief to low/middle earners; reinstate dividend tax credit; freeze unfunded public sector pensions; scrap PPF and NPSS.

Energy, environment, transport, housing
- Expand nuclear to up to 50% of electricity; support domestic coal; oppose most onshore wind, allow offshore if market-funded; repeal the Climate Change Act and related EU directives; end participation in carbon schemes; commission an independent review of climate evidence; invest in flood/coastal defences; promote electrified transport.
- Invest an extra £3bn p.a. in transport; roads and bypasses; fuel duty “windfall return”; local control over parking/speed cameras; charge foreign lorries; oppose 60-tonne lorries; three new high-speed rail lines; reopen lines; shift freight to rail/canals; Thames Estuary hub airport instead of expanding Heathrow/Gatwick/Stansted.
- Curb housing demand via immigration control; bring empty homes into use; scrap regional planning, the IPC, Section 106 and mandatory social-housing quotas; local binding referenda on major schemes; green belt conservators; bond-funded council social housing; scrap HIPs and empty property rates.

Culture, farming, fishing, other
- Protect key national brands; preserve traditional measures; strengthen curriculum on national contributions; measures against violent extremism; Sharia not to override UK law; Commonwealth Day; English Parliament; review Barnett formula; St George’s Day holiday.
- Agriculture: independent policy via WTO seat; gradual shift from subsidies to consumer-led support through labelling and pricing; GM research with clear labelling; ethical labelling; enable producer co-ops; supermarket ombudsman; local referendums on hunting.
- Fisheries: exit the CFP; 200nm EEZ; end quotas/discards; land all catches; movable no-take zones; ban industrial/pair trawling; bolster enforcement.
- Support animal welfare, Royal Mail/Post Offices, designated smoking rooms, and small businesses.
